admin.duplicates.title: Possible duplicates
admin.duplicates.intro: Spot records that may describe the same person. Nothing is merged without your confirmation.
admin.duplicates.idleBody: Run the scan: the most similar pairs will appear here, with their score.
admin.consistency.title: Tree consistency
admin.consistency.intro: Detects parentage loops and impossible or unusual dates. Nothing is fixed automatically: you review each case.
admin.consistency.idleBody: Run the check to verify the kinship links and dates of everyone in the tree.
admin.consistency.allClearBody: No loop or date inconsistency detected.
